question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I __regarded__ my brother on passing his graduation examination.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Congratulated'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** most appropriate** option that can substitute the word** "regarded" **in the given sentence is** "congratulated."**
 
• **Congratulated:** This word means to express joy, pleasure, or acknowledgment to someone for an achievement or success.(बधाई दी)
 
• In the** context of the sentence**, it indicates that the speaker expressed their positive feelings towards their brother for passing his graduation examination.
 
• It implies that the speaker acknowledged the accomplishment and offered their congratulations.
 
• 
 
**"Regarded"** means to look upon or consider someone in a certain way.(मान्यता) 

 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'I **congratulated **my brother on passing his graduation examination.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• **Disparaged: **This word means to belittle, criticize, or speak negatively about someone or something. (अपमानित)
 
• **Flattered: **This word means to praise or compliment someone excessively or insincerely in order to gain favor or manipulate them. (खुश किया)
 
• **Kowtowed:** This word means to show excessive subservience or deference to someone, often to an extreme or demeaning extent.(नमस्कार किया)
